subject: tr
title: TR.------PROG.CONT.
description: Diagram in TRF(II)-5 (Transformation, Level Two), on the page where Braxton argues that 'practically every country on the planet utilizes television, the functional utilization of this medium is controlled by only a select group of people who are not necessarily representative of the composite world group' — and that 'the realness of the present physical universe situation cannot be simply dismissed as unimportant — because it is important. The nature of the next transformation might well rest on how profoundly we understand those forces now dictating planet progressions in this time zone.' TR (transformation) is crossed with PROG-CONT (progressional continuance): the question is what transformation requires of progressional continuance in a media-controlled global context. PART (participation) branches from the main line at upper-left and carries OP-SD (option spread). RT-DY (reality dynamics) branches from the main line toward the lower right and carries SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars). TH-CONT-IMP drops from the main line and carries AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and C-INFO (composite information); from C-INFO runs LK-IMP (linkage implications), which carries INFO-RSOLD (information resolidification), which carries LANG-DY (language dynamics), which carries IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment).
